The report text of a failed run is for the wave entry check and is not part of the message standard. The business messages the journey produces are asserted as data on the owners' answers and are listed in section 14.

Screen states: SCR-13, SCR-18, SCR-19 and SCR-28 carry empty, loading, error and no-access states that this harness does not build.   Scenario: AC7 A hop whose decision record cannot be written moves nothing and the run fails (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision record of one hop of the journey is forced to fail to write
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-12-14
    Then the state change, the decision record and the outbox row of that hop are not written
    And the run stops at that hop, is reported failed and returns MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC8 A stale ACE data product behind a hop does not pass as today's data (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the data product behind the appraisal, the reconciliation or the read-back carries the previous business date
    When the harness runs the journey for business date 2026-12-14
    Then the hop does not treat the stale product as today's data
    And the run fails and the report names the product and the date it carries
    And MSG-P1-001 is returned by the owning service

edits.new: Thai text for each message follows decision DL10, which is still open and rests on assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863. The English text follows Error and Message Standard v4, and where the text of MSG-P1-001 above differs from that standard, the standard governs.

edits.old: Test data is synthetic; no production case, party, payment, guarantee, notice or partner record is copied, and no personal data is written to a report.
edits.new: Test data is synthetic; no production case, party, payment, guarantee, notice or partner record is copied, and no personal data is written to a report. Criteria and test data read the ACE views only through the rwb-source-data data product (DP-05); no criterion or test case names a view as a direct read. Reference data is read only through the reference-data contract (DP-06, DP-07): the fee tables that rwb-payment reads and the rule rows that rwb-decision reads take their parameters from those products, and the parameter names are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-W3J01-ITG-20).
